title: Summit Club Lounge Credit Against the Crestline Companion Reinstatement Fee
content:
For holders of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, a lounge credit is set against the reinstatement fee. It follows the holder's active membership in Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships:

| Holder's active Summit Club product | Lounge credit on the reinstatement fee |
|---|---|
| Summit Club Executive or Summit Club Lifetime | 15 USD |
| Summit Club Individual or Summit Club Individual Plus | 8 USD |
| no active membership, or any other club product | nothing |

Only a Summit Club membership in active status is read; Summit Club Essential and Summit Club Corporate give nothing.

**Hypothetical case.** A holder whose Summit Club Lifetime membership is active receives a credit of 15 USD; a holder whose Summit Club Individual membership is in grace receives nothing.
